description: This file defines classes and functions for monitoring and intercepting network requests in Firefox, including handling request/response events, request interception, redirect handling, and response storage, as part of the Mozilla codebase for network debugging or instrumentation.

classes.name: PageNetwork
classes.description: Manages network requests and responses for a specific page target, including request interception, headers, and response storage.

classes.name: NetworkRequest
classes.description: Represents an individual network request, handling interception, response data collection, and event emission.

classes.name: NetworkObserver
classes.description: Observes and manages network activity, redirects, and request lifecycle events across channels.

classes.name: ResponseStorage
classes.description: Stores response bodies with size limits, providing base64-encoded responses.

methods.name: forPageTarget
methods.description: Returns the PageNetwork instance for a given target.

methods.name: setExtraHTTPHeaders
methods.description: Sets additional HTTP headers for requests.

methods.name: combinedExtraHTTPHeaders
methods.description: Returns combined headers from target and instance.

methods.name: disableRequestInterception
methods.description: Disables request interception and resumes intercepted requests.

methods.name: resumeInterceptedRequest
methods.description: Resumes a intercepted request with new parameters.

methods.name: fulfillInterceptedRequest
methods.description: Fulfills an intercepted request with specified response.

methods.name: getResponseBody
methods.description: Retrieves the response body for a request as base64.

methods.name: _takeIntercepted
methods.description: Removes and returns an intercepted request by requestId.
